summary: Label engine reworked: candidates are priority-ordered (anchored search result, then the selected node, then landmarks by records), each label is measured (chars x font size) and lower-priority collisions are hidden, never stacked — anchors and the selection always keep their names. Labels are edge-aware: flipped below the node near the top of the stage and re-anchored near the sides. Declutter runs during settling, after class refreshes, after pan/zoom (debounced) and at glide end. Measured at the 1440x1000 acceptance viewport on the ambient fixture: 8 visible labels, 0 overlaps, 0 clipped. Fixture wording fixed: sample mode now says omitted names are 'omitted from this ambient sample — searchable once the live graph is connected'; 'live behind search' is reserved for a successful producer endpoint (and is now literally true against your shipped /v1/graph). Verified live against the real Valparai graph: hornbill search anchors Malabar Grey Hornbill with a legible top-priority label.
consumer_note: One interaction change shipped alongside, at the product owner's direction (not part of this proposal): 'Make this the focus' is removed — a search/selection now moves the CAMERA to the node (ease ~450ms) instead of pinning the node to the centre, and 'Show its connections' became a 'Spotlight connections' toggle (sticky hover-highlight); loading more neighbours appears only when the producer reports more to give ('Load N more connections'). Payload semantics, provenance, action handoff and merge-by-stable-id expansion are unchanged.
